layers.message: Add signup service with POST /signups endpoint

prompt.utterance: GRILL_ME on the request flow at beginner depth.

graderOnly: The request flow for POST /signups is: src/server.js reads the JSON body, calls createSignup in src/handlers/signup.js, which first calls validateSignup from src/validate.js and returns 400 on errors, then checks for a duplicate email (409), and only then persists with store.insert in src/store.js and returns 201.
Validation happens before persistence: an invalid request returns 400 and nothing is stored (covered by test/signup.test.js).
No prior quiz answers exist; this is the first turn of the conversation.

all.why: no quiz record or any other file is created

invariants.why: Navigator persists nothing (generated caches are ignored)

selfChecks.why: the existing tests pass, including that an invalid signup returns 400 and is not stored (validation before persistence)

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture with the default installed workflow state (no cycle; the case leaves state unspecified). Layer 00-project (pre-install, committed) is a small dependency-free Node ES-module service: src/server.js (node:http, POST /signups, JSON body parsing) -> src/handlers/signup.js createSignup -> src/validate.js validateSignup (400 on errors) -> duplicate check -> src/store.js SignupStore.insert (in-memory) -> 201. test/signup.test.js covers create, invalid-not-stored, and duplicate. Validation-before-persistence is visible in source. Git is clean and committed. No history, so no prior answers exist.
